experiments.purpose: Empirically verify which Pair functor methods admit ~Escapable arms after the type-level upgrade. CONFIRMED: init, swapped, apply (both arms), map(first:) / map(second:) on un-transformed arm. BLOCKED with diagnostics: map(first:second:) (Gap A); stdlib Equatable/Hashable/Comparable/Codable (intrinsic — protocols require Escapable).
experiments.statusDetail: All CONFIRMED variants compile clean across triple toolchain. BLOCKED variants documented in source comments with verbatim diagnostics. Outputs/build.txt + Outputs/build-6.4-dev.txt capture build logs.

experiments.purpose: Pre-publication exploration of whether Property.View patterns generalize to Pair's binary-product shape (5 variants). Concluded: not productive given Pair's flat type structure.
experiments.statusDetail: Variants explored, none adopted. Pair shipped with the static-canonical functor surface; Property.View patterns remain useful for other ecosystem types but not for Pair's flat shape.
